title: 第380章 科学从这里开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

如果是身为太子的刘盈，说出这样的一番话来，这会变成什么？

这就成为了许多人攻讦自己的借口。

刘盈甚至都能看到，自己直接就变成了无君无父，数典忘祖之人。

这样的一个人，还可以成为大汉帝国的太子吗？

当然不可以！

尤其是想到那个被烧死的先驱者……

虽然在大汉帝国没有人敢烧死自己，但是如果真的提出这些理论来，自己可能就因此而做不成皇帝了。

此刻刘盈真的是活生生自己把自己吓出来了一身冷汗。

正在一边上玩闹的臧儿和嬴月，立刻就发现了刘盈忽然不受控制的打了几个冷颤。

两人立刻就吓了一跳，急忙催促着让军医快点过来，如果太子在这个时候染病，情况就会变得非常棘手！

有人不想看到刘盈生病，那自然就有人想看到了刘盈生病。

头疼脑热都可能会丢掉性命的时代里边，没有谁不会畏惧生病。

刘盈喝住了要亲自跑出去叫人的安澜，摇头道：“我没事……”

臧儿凑了过来，紧张的摸了摸刘盈的额头。

可嬴月说：“不起作用的，需要眼睛挨着眼睛，如果觉得阿盈的眼睛发烫的话，那他就是发热了。”

刘盈想要推开用眼睛来贴着自己的眼睛为自己测量体温的臧儿，但是也不好打断她的好意。

测量过后，臧儿立刻松了一口气：“一样的，不感觉有点热，相反是我的眼睛有点热。”

看着嬴月要凑过来，刘盈立刻道：“我真的没有问题，方才……方才只是想到了什么让我自己都感到恐惧的事情，所以才会这样……”

“让你都感到恐惧的事情？”安澜立刻凑上前来，看着刘盈，等着刘盈说出那些人是该杀的人。

刘盈看着几人关切的眼神，忍不住笑了起来：“不是什么非常大的问题……我说不清楚，就是我自己有一些学识方面的东西，我想要拿出来给天下人学习。”

几人立刻松了一口气。

“阿盈你是太子，未来的皇帝，如果沉醉于什么学说这样的事情，恐怕不是好事，很容易让人钻空子的。”嬴月这一次都不用靠山提醒什么，就已经知道自己该表现出什么叫做规矩来了。

刘盈很无奈的看着嬴月道：“我所说的学说，就像是之前弄出来救人的青霉素一样，不是这个世界任何人所知道的一种东西。”

众人愕然的看着刘盈，刘盈尴尬的笑了一声：“我真的没有吹牛逼。”

“没有人觉得你在吹牛逼。”臧儿表情肃穆的看着刘盈：“阿盈，我们在一起的时间不久，你这些东西，究竟是跟着什么人学的？”

刘盈笑道：“臧儿，你应该清楚，就凭这句话，我就可以治罪与你……”

“你不会这样做。”臧儿非常有把握，他看着刘盈问道：“青霉素的制作，确实是匪夷所思，谁能想得到一些腐烂长出霉菌的脏东西里边，居然可以提炼出来就活人的好东西？”

“算了，我还是把学说说给你们听罢，如果你们觉得没有问题的话，我就自己著书立论，有些东西需要被传播开来。”

几人再度用一种非常认真地眼神看着自刘盈。

刘盈被他们用这种眼神看得有些不好意思，忍不住挠了挠头后，这才继续开口说道：“你们……你们知道我们脚下的大地，是什么样子的吗？”

“脚下的大地是什么样子？”

众人都被这个奇怪的问题弄得愣住了。

便是远处的靠山，这个时候也竖着耳朵。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

If Liu Ying, as the prince, said such words, what would happen?

This has become an excuse for many people to criticize themselves.

Liu Ying could even see that she had become a person without a king or a father, a person who had forgotten his ancestors.

Can such a person still become the prince of the Han Empire?

Of course not!

Especially thinking of the pioneer who was burned to death...

Although no one in the Han Empire dared to burn himself to death, if he really proposed these theories, he might not be able to become the emperor because of this.

At this moment, Liu Ying really scared herself into a cold sweat.

Zang'er and Ying Yue, who were playing around, immediately noticed that Liu Ying suddenly shivered uncontrollably.

The two of them were immediately startled and hurriedly urged the military doctor to come over quickly. If the prince got sick at this time, the situation would become very difficult!

Some people don't want to see Liu Ying get sick, so naturally some people want to see Liu Ying get sick.

In an era where a headache or a fever can cost your life, no one is afraid of getting sick.

Liu Ying stopped An Lan, who was about to run out to call someone, and shook her head: "I'm fine..."

Zang'er came over and nervously touched Liu Ying's forehead.

But Ying Yue said: "It doesn't work. You need to put your eyes next to your eyes. If you feel that A Ying's eyes are hot, then he has a fever."

Liu Ying wanted to push away Zang'er who put his eyes against hers to measure her temperature, but it was hard to interrupt her good intentions.

After the measurement, Zang'er immediately breathed a sigh of relief: "It's the same. I don't feel a little hot. On the contrary, my eyes are a little hot."

Seeing that Ying Yue was about to come over, Liu Ying immediately said: "I really have no problem. Just now...just now I just thought of something that made me feel scared, so I did this..."

"What scares you?" An Lan immediately came forward, looked at Liu Ying, and waited for Liu Ying to say those people should be killed.

Liu Ying looked at the concerned eyes of several people and couldn't help but laugh: "It's not a very big problem... I can't explain clearly, it's just that I have some knowledge of my own, and I want to show it to the world for learning."

Several people immediately breathed a sigh of relief.

"A Ying, you are the prince and the future emperor. If you indulge in such things as doctrine, it may not be a good thing. It will be easy for others to take advantage of the loopholes." Ying Yue didn't need to be reminded by her patron this time. She already knew what the rules were that she should show.

Liu Ying looked at Ying Yue helplessly and said: "The theory I am talking about is just like the penicillin that was used to save people. It is not something that anyone in this world knows."

Everyone looked at Liu Ying in astonishment, and Liu Ying laughed awkwardly: "I really didn't brag."

"No one thinks you are bragging." Zang'er looked at Liu Ying with a solemn expression: "Ah Ying, we have been together not long ago. Who did you learn these things from?"

Liu Ying smiled and said: "Zang'er, you should know that with just these words, I can punish you..."

"You won't do this." Zang Er was very confident. He looked at Liu Ying and asked: "The production of penicillin is indeed incredible. Who would have thought that some dirty things that rot and grow mold can actually be extracted into something good that can make people alive?"

"Forget it, I'll just tell you my theory. If you think there's no problem with it, I'll write a book and establish an argument myself. Some things need to be disseminated."

Several people looked at Zi Liu Ying again with very serious eyes.

Liu Ying was a little embarrassed by the way they looked at her. She couldn't help but scratch her head, and then she continued: "You...do you know what the earth beneath our feet looks like?"

"What does the ground look like under your feet?"

Everyone was stunned by this strange question.

Even the backer in the distance also had his ears pricked up at this time.
